articles.title: Trump Cancels $1 Billion in Spending — Without Asking Congress
articles.summary: President Trump just canceled nearly $1 billion that Congress already approved. The money was for refugee services, migrant students, and minority businesses. A Republican senator calls it illegal.

articles.title: Hurricane Nolo Is Crawling Toward Hawaii — And That's the Problem
articles.summary: Hurricane Nolo is heading toward Hawaii with winds up to 140 mph. It's moving super slowly — only 5 mph — which means it could dump up to 2 feet of rain. Flooding is the big danger.

articles.title: 700,000 People Pack Paris to See the Pope
articles.summary: About 700,000 people filled a square in Paris to see Pope Leo XIV. He rode down the Champs-Élysées in his popemobile and told young people they are "today's Church."
